title: Profile menu and account page
description:
## What's new

- The header now shows a **profile icon** that opens a dropdown menu.
- A new **Account** page lets you view your profile details.
- Language settings have moved from the header to the Account page.

## Why it changed

Grouping user-related settings under a single account page keeps the header clean and makes it easier to add more profile options later.

title: Change log page
description:
## What's new

- A **Change log** link is now available in the footer.
- Change log entries support Markdown descriptions, so updates can include formatted lists, links, and headings.

## What's next

- Real backend data will replace the mock entries shown today.

title: Book collection and PDF reader
description:
## What's new

- Browse the library collection with search and pagination.
- View book details in a modal.
- Open a dedicated PDF reader tab for books with an online copy.

> The current PDF reader uses Google Drive preview links; a backend proxy will replace these in a future release.

title: Initial release
description:
## What's new

- Login page with mock authentication.
- Support for English and Brazilian Portuguese.
- Responsive layout built with Vue 3, Vite, Pinia, and Vue Router.
